# Third-party libraries used in this folder

- **qrcode.min.js** — [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT License.
- **bcrypt.min.js** — [bcrypt.js](https://github.com/dcodeIO/bcrypt.js) by Daniel Wirtz. Apache License 2.0.
- **md5.min.js** — [blueimp-md5](https://github.com/blueimp/JavaScript-MD5) by Sebastian Tschan. MIT License.
- **beautify.min.js / beautify-css.min.js / beautify-html.min.js** — [js-beautify](https://github.com/beautifier/js-beautify). MIT License.
- **js-yaml.min.js** — [js-yaml](https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml). MIT License.
- **sql-formatter.min.js** — [sql-formatter](https://github.com/sql-formatter-org/sql-formatter). MIT License.
- **cronstrue.min.js** — [cronstrue](https://github.com/bradymholt/cRonstrue) by Brady Holt. MIT License.
- **pdf-lib.min.js** — [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib). MIT License.

All are pure client-side JavaScript with no external dependencies, vendored locally so the site keeps working with no backend and no third-party script requests.
